info.name: Microsoft Azure Creates Or Updates A Management Lock At The Resource Group Level

params.name: resourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the resource group to lock.

params.name: lockName
params.description: The lock name. The lock name can be a maximum of 260 characters. It cannot contain <, > %, &, :, \, ?, /, or any control characters.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

items.docs: When you apply a lock at a parent scope, all child resources inherit the same lock. To create management locks, you must have access to Microsoft.Authorization/* or Microsoft.Authorization/locks/* actions. Of the built-in roles, only Owner and User Access Administrator are granted those actions.

params.description: The name of lock to delete.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

items.docs: To delete management locks, you must have access to Microsoft.Authorization/* or Microsoft.Authorization/locks/* actions. Of the built-in roles, only Owner and User Access Administrator are granted those actions.
